label: the neutral guard is dropped: a zero contrast still runs a contrast pass
contrast runs before exposure
find:
if s.exposure != 0 { p.append(.exposure(Float(s.exposure))) }
        if s.contrast != 0 { p.append(.contrast(Float(s.contrast))) }
replace:
if s.contrast != 0 { p.append(.contrast(Float(s.contrast))) }
        if s.exposure != 0 { p.append(.exposure(Float(s.exposure))) }

label: the histogram counts linear values, not the sRGB values of the buffer it is given
find: let h = try Histogram(of: buffer, bins: HistogramBins.binCount, encoding: .sRGB)
replace: let h = try Histogram(of: buffer, bins: HistogramBins.binCount, encoding: .linear)

label: Whites raises the white point instead of lowering it
the turn is skipped: a straightened crop cuts the upright pixels
find: let turned = crop.angle == 0 ? b : try b.rotated(degrees: crop.angle, filter: .lanczos3)
replace: let turned = true ? b : try b.rotated(degrees: crop.angle, filter: .lanczos3)
